needed_lemma: 需要一致误差以交换 n 趋无穷与 p 趋一两个极限。
unproved_interface: Need a joint finite-size/near-one error estimate to interchange n→∞ and p↑1; the author page gives a heuristic only.

needed_lemma: 图加边不单调地帮助或阻碍唯一白邻居条件，不能使用普通渗流支配。
unproved_interface: The paper proves the path comparison for sufficiently large trees, but the conjecture is for every graph; close this general-graph gap.

needed_lemma: 团外路径可联合触发团内强迫，确定性零强迫数下界不足以控制随机阈值。
unproved_interface: Conjecture 6.1 in the source asks the same clique lower bound; no proof or counterexample is supplied.

needed_lemma: 固定宽度传递矩阵的状态数呈指数增长，常数不一定对 m 一致。
unproved_interface: Source Problem 6.3 leaves the joint m,n grid-threshold order open; available bounds do not match uniformly.

needed_lemma: 对每棵固定树常数时间已知，难点是关于树大小的尖锐统一线性界。
unproved_interface: For each fixed tree a bound O(v(T)^2) is known, but the sharp uniform dependence on tree size and star extremality remain unresolved.

needed_lemma: 已知构造常把 n 变成 Cn；没有正则增长性时不能直接比较原尺寸最大值。
unproved_interface: Need a comparison preserving the same n and a lower bound for the restriction to percolating starts; random-host weak-saturation papers optimize a sequential edge order, not synchronous running time.

needed_lemma: 平均度接近2仍可能很慢，必须利用最大度3与叶节点同时存在。
unproved_interface: Need an upper bound using both minimum degree 1 and maximum degree 3; survey reports no theorem covering the full class.

needed_lemma: 规则包含两个不相交组件，但宿主中的组件见证可随时间反复重用，直观独立分解失效。
unproved_interface: Need a construction or inequality for disconnected H under synchronous rounds; two component witnesses can be reused across time.

needed_lemma: For the two-dimensional Hamming-plane Young-diagram rule, use the rectangle-to-plane spanning equivalence in Gravner–Sivakoff–Slivken; the remaining seed-size target is the stronger general inequality γ(Z)≥|Z|/2.
unproved_interface: No finite-to-infinite closure gap remains when the A200 dynamics and initial-set hypotheses match this paper: a finite seed supported in any rectangle containing Z spans the whole plane iff it internally spans the rectangle, and Theorem 1.2 confines a minimum seed to such a rectangle. Theorem 1.1 proves only γ(Z)≥|Z|/4 and the authors leave any improvement open, so prove or disprove the stronger γ(Z)≥|Z|/2 target separately.
auxiliary_source_note: BBDM12 is a model-bound comparison only: fixed-dimensional finite-grid nearest-neighbour r-bootstrap threshold; its R03 helper review explicitly found no general infection-time tail or Hamming-plane seed conclusion.

needed_lemma: 有限盒未定只代表边界信息尚未传播，不能据此证明无限局面平局。
unproved_interface: Need a minimax strategy/result on the infinite random board; oriented-percolation survival alone does not imply a draw.

needed_lemma: 最优策略依赖已经走过的路径，局面不是原始占据图上的简单 Markov 状态。
unproved_interface: Need path-dependent game analysis in both dimensions; finite boxes and ordinary percolation connectivity do not decide infinite optimal play.

needed_lemma: 不能将最终未感染集合的空间指数尾直接当成感染时间尾界。
unproved_interface: Hartarsky proves exponential decay above q-tilde_c in 2D and records q_c≤q-tilde_c; establish equality or control q_c<q≤q-tilde_c, and check the question’s dimension/class.
auxiliary_source_note: BBDM12 is a model-bound comparison only: fixed-dimensional finite-grid nearest-neighbour r-bootstrap threshold; its R03 helper review explicitly found no general infection-time tail or Hamming-plane seed conclusion.

needed_lemma: 除常数 p 下的 (1+o(1)) 随机弱饱和数结论外，核对结构性假设下是否已有稀疏宿主中的整数精确稳定。Theorem 1.4 的前提是对所有 n 有 wsat(n,F)≥(δ(F)−1)n+D（D 只依赖 F）；在该前提下，wsat(n,F)=(δ(F)−1)n+d_F eventually，且 p≥n^{-1/(2k+3)}log n 时随机宿主中 w.h.p. 精确相等。
unproved_interface: Theorem 1.4 proves exact equality under its structural lower-bound hypothesis (which the paper verifies for complete graphs, complete bipartite graphs, minimum-degree-1 graphs, and minimum-degree-2 graphs that are connected or have no cut edge). For a target F outside these checked classes, prove wsat(n,F)≥(δ(F)−1)n+D for every n, and verify the target p meets n^{-1/(2k+3)}log n; otherwise exact equality is unsupported by this source. The fixed-p Theorem 1.3 gives only (1+o(1)) asymptotics.

needed_lemma: 确定性最小强迫集占一半不意味着随机密度一半可成功；fort 事件高度相关。
unproved_interface: Problem 6.2 in the source asks the same hypercube limit and states only c≥1/2; existence and value remain open.

needed_lemma: 蓝色核心中的内部边提高计数却不提供传播能力，这是原文指出的障碍。
unproved_interface: Need the sparse p=(log n)^(-omega(1)) regime and leading log_4(1/p) constant under the stated probabilistic forcing rule.

needed_lemma: 接近连通阈值的局部展开不均匀，最后若干顶点可能主导完成时间。
unproved_interface: Need high-probability propagation time for p=c log n/n; existing estimates assume pn≫log n and are not uniform at this boundary.

needed_lemma: 方向可形成长程依赖的探索过程，不能视作独立有向键。
unproved_interface: Need to handle dependence created by exploring the oriented square model; do not substitute independent oriented bond percolation.

needed_lemma: 有限盒求解只验证固定边界型，不能覆盖任意外部路径。
unproved_interface: Prove the universal bounded-radius path surgery first, then verify it meets the definition of an essential enhancement.

needed_lemma: 对固定角配置的集中界不能直接覆盖连续角空间。
unproved_interface: Scope mismatch: this is a signed-graph synchronization threshold, not a percolation/infection process; no W05 renormalization theorem is identified.

needed_lemma: 下界已逼近二次指数；随机-host percolation 阈值与 weak-saturation 数值不是同步运行时间，不能代替所需的轮数上界。
unproved_interface: For K5, combine the n^(2-o(1)) lower bound with only a constant-proportion n^2 upper bound; the o(n^2) assertion remains undecided. Random-host threshold and sequential weak-saturation results do not give a synchronous-round upper bound.

needed_lemma: 普通单调性不能排除指数随尺度振荡，构造放大可能改变传播时序。
unproved_interface: Need a scale-uniform growth regularity principle ruling out oscillation of log M_H(n)/log n for arbitrary fixed H.

needed_lemma: 极值图的边数与感染历史的边证据分配不同，需要额外时间结构。
unproved_interface: Need a time-structure bound stronger than edge-count/Turán-density control; no o(ex(n,H)) result for all fixed bipartite H is supplied.

needed_lemma: 一般图已有非单调例，不能忽略格点及参数相对次序。
unproved_interface: Need model-specific coupling/monotonicity for two-type Richardson growth on the fixed lattice; single-type oriented percolation results do not imply coexistence monotonicity.

needed_lemma: 簇内随机连接路径造成不可统一的拼接损失。
unproved_interface: Need a subadditive limit theorem on the random infinite cluster and control of connector cost; chemical-distance estimates alone do not provide the required SAW count limit.

needed_lemma: 稀疏簇可能产生长瓶颈；原图的有限能流不必能限制到簇内。
unproved_interface: Need to transfer a finite-energy/transience witness from the Cayley graph to every infinite percolation cluster; sparse bottlenecks obstruct a direct restriction argument.

needed_lemma: 可和性、零熵与零速度的等价范围必须核对，不能混用。
unproved_interface: Need precise hypotheses relating speed, entropy and volume growth for both the Cayley walk and cluster walk; supercritical geometry alone is insufficient.

needed_lemma: 单端并不直接给出可用于 Peierls 估计的统一小环结构。
unproved_interface: Need a uniform uniqueness-threshold argument for arbitrary one-ended quasi-transitive graphs; slab results on Z^d do not cover this class.

needed_lemma: 非可和方向和某些群类已知；一般可和群的几何缺少欧氏维数递推。
unproved_interface: Need both directions for all finite generating sets and all k-rules; tree/nonamenable examples do not establish the amenable-group converse.
